One Earth Bioregions Framework layers (packaged)

Source: R/data.R
oe_data.Rd

Packaged spatial layers of the One Earth Bioregions Framework, stored as wrapped terra::SpatVector objects (see terra::wrap). Use oe_layer() or terra::unwrap() to materialise them.

oe_realms

oe_subrealms

oe_bioregions

oe_ecoregions

Format

Wrapped SpatVector polygon layers in EPSG:4326, simplified to keep the package lightweight (use oe_layer(layer, full = TRUE) for the original geometries):

oe_realms

14 biogeographical realms (~0.02 deg tolerance).

oe_subrealms

53 subrealms (~0.02 deg).

oe_bioregions

185 bioregions, coded by realm prefix + number (~0.02 deg).

oe_ecoregions

847 ecoregions from RESOLVE Ecoregions 2017 (~0.15 deg).

Source

One Earth Bioregions Framework (2023), https://www.oneearth.org, licensed CC BY-NC 4.0 (non-commercial use, cite One Earth); Ecoregions: Dinerstein et al. (2017) doi:10.1093/biosci/bix014 , licensed CC-BY 4.0.
